info.title: SOVA API
info.summary: REST API for the SOVA multitenant issue tracker.
info.description: The contract starts with the technical foundation endpoints and is extended together with every API implementation checkpoint.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Cookie-based authentication and revocable server sessions

tags.name: Tenancy
tags.description: Authenticated tenant discovery and tenant context

tags.name: Security audit
tags.description: Immutable, permission-checked system and tenant security events

get.summary: Get API metadata

200.description: API metadata
The credentials were verified and session cookies were issued.

Set-Cookie.description: The HttpOnly session and readable CSRF cookies.

get.summary: Get the current authenticated identity
get.description: Restores the effective user profile, explicit SUPERADMIN context and optional session-bound impersonation. No credential or session token is returned.

200.description: The current authenticated identity.

post.description: Always returns the same accepted response for a syntactically valid email, regardless of account existence or recovery throttling.

202.description: The recovery request was accepted without disclosing account existence.

post.summary: Set a new password using a one-time token

204.description: The password was replaced and all existing sessions were revoked.

post.description: Always returns the same accepted response for a syntactically valid email, regardless of account existence, account state, or throttling.

202.description: The request was accepted without disclosing account existence or state.

post.summary: Verify an email using a one-time token

200.description: The email is verified. Reusing the same consumed token is idempotent.

post.description: The token is sent in the request body so reverse-proxy access logs do not contain it.

200.description: Safe invitation details for the token holder.

post.summary: Create a verified account from an invitation
post.description: This is the only public account-creation operation. User, verified email, active membership, and consumed invitation are committed atomically.

201.description: The verified user and active membership were created.

post.summary: Accept an invitation with the authenticated account

200.description: The invitation was accepted for the matching account.

204.description: The current session was revoked and its cookies were cleared.

get.summary: List active sessions for the current user

200.description: Active, non-revoked sessions.

delete.summary: Revoke one session owned by the current user

get.summary: List tenants for system administration
get.description: Requires the current separate SUPERADMIN system role. Returns every non-deleted tenant with lifecycle revision and administrative metadata.

200.description: The system tenant catalog.

post.summary: Create a pending tenant and invite its first owner
post.description: Requires SUPERADMIN. Creates the tenant, provisions immutable default roles and publishes a TENANT_OWNER invitation atomically. The tenant becomes ACTIVE when that invitation is accepted. Reusing the same Idempotency-Key and body safely replays the result.

200.description: An earlier successful request with the same idempotency key was replayed.

201.description: The pending tenant and owner invitation were created.

patch.description: Requires SUPERADMIN, a reason and the current optimistic revision. Direct transition to DELETED is unavailable; DELETION_PENDING starts a 30-day grace period and can be cancelled back to ARCHIVED.

200.description: The tenant is in the requested status.

get.summary: List every global user account
get.description: Requires system.users.manage. Access itself is appended to the security audit.

200.description: Every global user account.

patch.summary: Change a global user account status
patch.description: Requires system.users.manage. Only ACTIVE and DISABLED are accepted as targets; PENDING_VERIFICATION and LOCKED may still transition into either through the existing account state machine. Own account changes are rejected, and disabling the last active superadmin's account is rejected.

200.description: The user account is in the requested status.

put.description: Requires system.superadmins.manage. Repeating an existing grant is idempotent.

200.description: The user holds the SUPERADMIN role.

delete.description: Requires system.superadmins.manage. Rejects revoking your own role and rejects removing the last active superadmin. Repeating a missing grant is idempotent.

200.description: The user no longer holds the SUPERADMIN role.

get.summary: List immutable system security audit events
get.description: Requires system.audit.view. SUPERADMIN receives a newest-first keyset page across system and tenant contexts. Access to this endpoint is itself appended to the audit.

200.description: A newest-first page of immutable security audit events.

post.description: Requires system.impersonate through the non-impersonated SUPERADMIN context, the current administrator password, a support reason, an active target membership and an active tenant. The context is bound to the current server session and expires after at most 15 minutes.

201.description: The effective identity was switched to the selected tenant user.

delete.description: Ends an active, expired or invalidated impersonation on the current server session and restores the real actor identity.

get.summary: List tenants accessible to the current user
get.description: Regular users receive only active tenants backed by an active membership. SUPERADMIN receives every non-deleted tenant without requiring membership.

200.description: Tenants available to the authenticated session.

get.summary: Resolve an authorized tenant context
get.description: The tenant identifier comes from the route. A foreign, inactive, deleted, or otherwise inaccessible tenant is returned as not found. SUPERADMIN may explicitly enter every non-deleted tenant and that access is audited.

200.description: The requested tenant context is accessible.

post.summary: Create and queue a tenant invitation
post.description: Requires tenant.members.invite or the SUPERADMIN bypass. The plaintext token is never returned by the API.

201.description: The invitation and encrypted delivery event were created.

get.summary: List immutable security events for one tenant
get.description: Requires tenant.audit.view in the route-derived tenant context. Events from every other tenant are excluded in the repository query. Access to this endpoint is itself appended to the tenant audit.

200.description: A newest-first page containing only this tenant's immutable security events.

get.summary: Export immutable security events for one tenant as CSV
get.description: Requires tenant.audit.export in the route-derived tenant context. Applies the same filters and redaction as the list endpoint, internally follows the keyset cursor up to a bounded row cap, and returns a single CSV attachment instead of a paginated JSON page. The export itself is appended to the tenant audit.

200.description: A CSV attachment containing up to 5000 newest-first matching events.

Content-Disposition.description: Attachment filename for the CSV export.

get.summary: List every workgroup in a tenant

200.description: Every workgroup in the tenant.

patch.description: Requires tenant.workgroups.manage, or workgroup.manage on this specific workgroup. ACTIVE and ARCHIVED toggle in either direction; repeating the current status is idempotent.

200.description: The workgroup is in the requested status.

get.summary: List the members of a workgroup
get.description: Requires tenant.workgroups.manage, or workgroup.view on this specific workgroup.

200.description: Every member of the workgroup.

put.summary: Add a workgroup member or change their role
put.description: Requires tenant.workgroups.manage, or workgroup.members.manage on this specific workgroup. The tenant membership must be active. Idempotent when the member already holds the requested role.

200.description: The membership holds the requested workgroup role.

delete.description: Requires tenant.workgroups.manage, or workgroup.members.manage on this specific workgroup. Repeating a missing membership is idempotent.

204.description: The membership is no longer part of the workgroup.

get.summary: List every project in a tenant

200.description: Every project in the tenant.

post.description: Requires tenant.projects.create. A private project requires lead_membership_id, which is assigned PROJECT_MANAGER.

patch.description: Requires tenant.projects.manage, or project.settings.manage on this specific project. ACTIVE and ARCHIVED toggle in either direction; repeating the current status is idempotent.

200.description: The project is in the requested status.

get.summary: List the roles defined for a project
get.description: Requires tenant.projects.manage, or project.view on this specific project.

200.description: Every role defined for the project.

get.summary: List the members of a project
get.description: Requires tenant.projects.manage, or project.view on this specific project.

200.description: Every member of the project, with their assigned roles.

put.summary: Assign a project role to a tenant membership
put.description: Requires tenant.projects.manage, or project.members.manage on this specific project. The tenant membership and the project role must both be active. Idempotent when the membership already holds the role.

204.description: The membership holds the project role.

delete.summary: Remove a project role from a tenant membership
delete.description: Requires tenant.projects.manage, or project.members.manage on this specific project. Repeating a missing assignment is idempotent.

204.description: The membership no longer holds the project role.

get.summary: List the workgroups linked to a project
get.description: Requires tenant.projects.manage, or project.view on this specific project.

200.description: Every workgroup linked to the project, with its granted role.

put.summary: Link a workgroup to a project or change its role
put.description: Requires tenant.projects.manage, or project.members.manage on this specific project. The workgroup and the project role must both be active. Upserts the role when the workgroup is already linked.

204.description: The workgroup is linked to the project with the requested role.

delete.summary: Unlink a workgroup from a project
delete.description: Requires tenant.projects.manage, or project.members.manage on this specific project. Repeating a missing link is idempotent.

204.description: The workgroup is no longer linked to the project.

get.summary: List tenant roles and assignable permission definitions
get.description: Requires tenant.roles.view. System-scoped permissions are never returned as tenant-role options.

200.description: Tenant roles and the non-system permission catalog.

post.description: Requires tenant.roles.manage. The immutable role code must be unique within the tenant. Only non-system permissions may be selected and all catalog dependencies must be included.

201.description: The custom tenant role was created.

put.description: Requires tenant.roles.manage. The role code and system roles are immutable. The complete non-system permission set is replaced after validating dependencies, and revision provides optimistic concurrency control.

200.description: The custom tenant role was updated.

delete.summary: Archive an unassigned custom tenant role
delete.description: Requires tenant.roles.manage. System roles cannot be archived, and a custom role must first be removed from every membership. Repeating the archive of an already archived custom role is idempotent.

204.description: The custom tenant role is archived.

get.summary: List tenant memberships and their tenant roles
get.description: Requires tenant.members.view. The administrative list includes active, disabled, and removed memberships; it never exposes password data.

200.description: Tenant memberships with user identity and assigned tenant roles.

patch.summary: Change a tenant membership lifecycle status
patch.description: Requires tenant.members.manage. ACTIVE may transition to DISABLED or REMOVED, DISABLED may transition to ACTIVE or REMOVED, and REMOVED is terminal. Own membership changes are blocked. Any membership holding TENANT_OWNER additionally requires tenant.roles.manage and the last active owner can never be deactivated or removed.

200.description: The membership is in the requested status. Repeating the current status is idempotent.

put.summary: Assign a tenant role to an active membership
put.description: Requires tenant.roles.assign. Assigning TENANT_OWNER additionally requires tenant.roles.manage. Repeating an existing assignment is idempotent.

delete.summary: Remove a tenant role from a membership
delete.description: Requires tenant.roles.assign. Removing TENANT_OWNER additionally requires tenant.roles.manage and cannot remove the last active tenant owner. Repeating a missing assignment is idempotent.

204.description: The tenant role is not assigned to the membership.

get.summary: Check API liveness
get.description: Alias of the dedicated liveness endpoint. It does not check external dependencies.

get.summary: Check API liveness
Check API and PostgreSQL readiness

200.description: The API and all required dependencies are ready.

503.description: At least one required dependency is not ready.

sessionCookie.name: sova_session
sessionCookie.description: Opaque server-session token. The cookie is HttpOnly.

csrfHeader.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrfHeader.description: Token copied from the readable sova_csrf cookie for unsafe requests.

AuditCursor.name: cursor
AuditCursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor returned as next_cursor by the previous page.

Problem.description: A request error represented as RFC 9457 Problem Details.

is_superadmin.description: True only when the user currently holds the separate SUPERADMIN system role.

next_cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor for the next page, or null at the end.

membership_id.description: Active membership identifier, or null when access is granted by SUPERADMIN.

code.description: Stable tenant-local role identifier. It cannot be changed or reused after archival.

permissions.description: Complete set of non-system permission codes, including every declared dependency.
Complete replacement set of non-system permission codes, including every declared dependency.

revision.description: Revision returned by the most recent role read.

request_id.description: Correlation identifier matching the X-Request-ID header.

code.description: Stable machine-readable generic or domain error code.

errors.description: Optional field error map for validation problems.
